response.overview: A homeless man returns to his old apartment building in search of shelter. Turned away by an old friend living there with his pregnant wife, he wanders through rooms haunted by memories, loneliness and buried secrets. After falling asleep outside during a summer rain, he wakes in a peaceful landscape filled with cows, as though decades have passed. There he encounters an apparition of Maria Ozawa, and reality, memory and desire begin to merge. Longing to escape his human existence, he takes his own life in the belief that he may be reborn as a cow.
